advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: How every AI request is shaped. These apply to whichever provider is active, and they are saved together because they depend on one another.
advanced.temperatureHelp: How freely the model writes. 0 stays close to the text, 2 is the most inventive.
advanced.maxTokensHelp: The most tokens one answer may use.
advanced.dailyLimitHelp: The most AI requests Yana makes in a day.
advanced.monthlyLimitHelp: The most AI requests Yana makes in a month. At least as large as the daily limit.
advanced.maxPromptLengthHelp: The most characters sent to the provider in a single request — an article being summarized, or a prompt sent from the mobile app.
advanced.requestTimeoutHelp: How long Yana waits for an answer before it gives up on a request.
advanced.maxRetriesHelp: The most times a failed request is tried again. 0 means never.
advanced.retryDelayHelp: How long Yana waits before it tries a failed request again.
advanced.requestDelayHelp: How long Yana waits between two consecutive requests.
advanced.temperatureRange: The temperature must be between 0 and 2 — every supported provider refuses a higher value.
advanced.maxTokensRange: The token limit must be between 1 and 200000. Zero would produce an empty summary every time.
advanced.dailyLimitRange: The daily request limit must be between 1 and 100000.
advanced.monthlyLimitRange: The monthly request limit must be between 1 and 100000.
advanced.monthlyBelowDaily: The monthly request limit must be at least as large as the daily one, otherwise the daily limit could never be reached.
advanced.maxPromptLengthRange: The prompt length must be between 1 and 100000 characters.
advanced.requestTimeoutRange: The request timeout must be between 5 and 600 seconds. Below five seconds no provider ever answers in time.
advanced.maxRetriesRange: The retry count must be between 0 and 10.
advanced.retryDelayRange: The delay between retries must be between 0 and 60 seconds.
advanced.requestDelayRange: The delay between requests must be between 0 and 60 seconds.
